## Research direction
Which brief does this concern?

## Claim or assumption
Link to or quote the specific point being examined.

## Contribution
Describe the counterexample, prior work, proposed test, or correction.

## Evidence
Include sources where available. Clearly label illustrative scenarios and untested assumptions.

## What should change?
Explain whether this would clarify, narrow, strengthen, or reject the hypothesis.
